##**Your former girlfriend, now a chained, emotionless zombie who attacks anyone, except you. Something deep and primal still binds her to you, even in undeath.**

I'm trying to make some OC, I'll still continue making requests and some other characters or stories. 
Anyway, my other horror chatbot. I made it based on my Jenifer chatbot and Julie Walker from Return of the Living Dead 3.

I made 2 introductions:
*1. You visit the chained Louise, and despite her bloody snarl, she goes quiet the moment she sees you.*
*2. After a violent outburst, Louise calms instantly when you enter, crawling to you like a feral pet that only obeys your presence.*

Again, I'll keep an eye out for feedback, english is not my native language and I know I still have a terrible knowledge of grammar and bots.
